; MajorTom for the native reMarkable reader (xochitl).
;
; Translates text picked out of a book and offers to save it, in the menu that
; appears when text is highlighted or picked with the selection tool. That menu
; is reMarkable's own, shipped behind the `[Experimental] GlyphSelection` flag;
; it offers only Copy.
;
; Everything lives in this one file on purpose. The Save handler needs the open
; document and page, which belong to the reader view further up the tree; rather
; than patch that much larger file too, it walks up the parent chain at runtime.
; One patched file is one place to break when reMarkable ships an update.
;
; Files are written with XMLHttpRequest, which XOVI's service override already
; allows (QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_WRITE=1).

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/GlyphSelectionHandler.qml
    TRAVERSE GlyphSelection#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            // "" until translated. mtFailed distinguishes "no translation yet"
            // from "tried and could not reach the translator".
            property string mtTranslation: ""
            property bool mtBusy: false
            property bool mtFailed: false
            readonly property bool mtTranslated: mtTranslation !== "" || mtFailed

            // Lets the reader view start a fresh quote after a save, rather
            // than folding the next highlight into the one just saved.
            signal mtSaved()

            // There is no Translate button: showing the menu is the request.
            // Only a menu on screen is translated -- reMarkable's own handler
            // sets text on a menu it then destroys without showing, once per
            // highlight, and that one must not cost a request.
            function mtTranslateIfShown() {
                if (root.visible && root._selectedText) {
                    Qt.callLater(root.mtTranslate);
                }
            }

            onVisibleChanged: root.mtTranslateIfShown()

            on_SelectedTextChanged: {
                root.mtTranslation = "";
                root.mtBusy = false;
                root.mtFailed = false;
                // Covers a line joining the quote while the menu is open.
                root.mtTranslateIfShown();
            }

            // Text from a laid-out page carries its line breaks, including
            // words hyphenated across lines ("unruhi-\ngen").
            function mtCleanText() {
                return root.selectedText
                    .replace(/­/g, "")
                    .replace(/-\s*\n\s*/g, "")
                    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                    .trim();
            }

            // The reader view owns the document and page; the document view
            // above it owns the notification bar.
            function mtFindUp(test) {
                let p = root.parent;
                while (p && !test(p)) {
                    p = p.parent;
                }
                return p;
            }

            function mtTranslate() {
                let text;
                try {
                    text = root.mtCleanText();
                } catch (e) {
                    // Dismissed between being scheduled and running.
                    return;
                }
                if (!text) {
                    return;
                }
                root.mtBusy = true;
                const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        return;
                    }
                    try {
                        // A line joined the quote while this was out: the
                        // answer is for text no longer on screen.
                        if (root.mtCleanText() !== text) {
                            return;
                        }
                        root.mtBusy = false;
                        try {
                            const data = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                            root.mtTranslation = data[0].map(part => part[0]).join("").trim();
                            root.mtFailed = root.mtTranslation === "";
                        } catch (e) {
                            root.mtFailed = true;
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        // The menu was closed, and this object with it.
                    }
                };
                // German, not auto-detect: a single inflected word is too
                // little to detect from ("auserlesene" came back as Norwegian).
                xhr.open("GET", "https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single"
                         + "?client=gtx&sl=de&tl=en&dt=t&q=" + encodeURIComponent(text));
                xhr.send();
            }

            function mtSave(kind) {
                const scene = root.mtFindUp(p => p.document !== undefined && p.page !== undefined);
                // Resolved now, not in the write callback: closing the menu
                // destroys this object, and the write finishes after that.
                const view = root.mtFindUp(p => typeof p.showNotification === "function");
                const doc = scene ? scene.document : null;
                const entry = {
                    kind: kind,
                    text: root.mtCleanText(),
                    translation: root.mtTranslation,
                    context: "",
                    page: scene ? scene.page + 1 : 0,
                    book: doc ? doc.visibleName : "",
                    // A QUuid, which JSON.stringify renders as {}.
                    document_id: doc ? String(doc.id).replace(/[{}]/g, "") : "",
                    source: "xochitl",
                    saved_at: new Date().toISOString()
                };

                // One file per save: nothing is ever read back and rewritten,
                // so a failed write can lose that save and nothing else.
                const path = "/home/root/.majortom/inbox/" + Date.now() + ".json";
                const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE && view) {
                        view.showNotification(entry.text.length > 40
                                              ? qsTr("Saved to MajorTom")
                                              : qsTr("Saved: ") + entry.text);
                    }
                };
                xhr.open("PUT", "file://" + path);
                xhr.send(JSON.stringify(entry));
                root.mtSaved();
                root.close();
            }

            Rectangle {
                id: mtPanel
                visible: selectionMenu.visible && (root.mtTranslated || root.mtBusy)
                width: Math.min(Math.max(selectionMenu.width, 480), root.width - 80)
                height: mtPanelText.implicitHeight + 40
                x: Math.max(40, Math.min(selectionMenu.x, root.width - width - 40))
                // Below the menu when there is room, otherwise above it.
                y: selectionMenu.y + selectionMenu.height + 16 + height < root.height
                   ? selectionMenu.y + selectionMenu.height + 16
                   : selectionMenu.y - height - 16
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 3
                radius: 16

                // The handler closes itself on any tap outside the menu; taps
                // on the panel should not count as outside.
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                }

                Text {
                    id: mtPanelText
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    anchors.margins: 20
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    color: "black"
                    font.pixelSize: 30
                    text: root.mtBusy ? qsTr("Translating…")
                        : root.mtFailed ? qsTr("Could not translate — no connection? You can still save it.")
                        : root.mtTranslation
                }
            }
        }

        TRAVERSE SelectionContextualMenu#selectionMenu
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    type: selectionMenu.type
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/star"
                    text: qsTr("Save word")
                    visible: root.mtTranslated
                    onClicked: root.mtSave("word")
                }

                ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    type: selectionMenu.type
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/star_fill"
                    text: qsTr("Save phrase")
                    visible: root.mtTranslated
                    onClicked: root.mtSave("phrase")
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Opening the same menu from the highlighter.
;
; The highlighter's stroke goes to highlightWithLine, which draws the highlight
; and hands no text back. The selection tool's goes to selectWithLine, which
; reports the glyphs under it -- that is what fills the menu above. So after a
; highlight snapped to text, run the selection lookup on the same stroke and
; open the menu with what it finds.
;
; Only listeners are added; no function reMarkable wrote is replaced. Their own
; onAreaSelected still runs and, seeing the highlighter rather than the
; selection tool, closes any glyph selection -- so the menu is reopened with
; Qt.callLater, after every handler for the event has had its turn.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool mtFromHighlight: false
            property var mtAreas: null
            property string mtText: ""

            function mtOpenFromHighlight() {
                if (!root.mtFromHighlight) {
                    return;
                }
                root.mtFromHighlight = false;
                mtHighlightTimeout.stop();
                if (!root.mtText) {
                    return;
                }
                glyphSelectionRoot.active = true;
                root.glyphSelection.setSelection(root.mtAreas, root.mtText);
                root.glyphSelection.open();
                root.mtText = "";
                root.mtAreas = null;
            }

            // If the lookup finds no text -- a highlight over an image, say --
            // no signal arrives, and the flag must not leak into the next
            // ordinary selection.
            Timer {
                id: mtHighlightTimeout
                interval: 1500
                onTriggered: {
                    root.mtFromHighlight = false;
                    root.mtText = "";
                    root.mtAreas = null;
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: strokeHandler
                function onStrokeCompleted(stroke) {
                    if (!stroke.isHighlighter
                        || !documentViewTools.activePen.snapHighlighterToText
                        || !Experimental.glyphSelection.enabled
                        || !root.controller) {
                        return;
                    }
                    root.mtFromHighlight = true;
                    mtHighlightTimeout.restart();
                    root.controller.selectWithLine(stroke, SceneController.IgnoreTapGesture);
                }
            }

            Connections {
                target: root.controller
                function onGlyphsSelected(areas, text) {
                    if (!root.mtFromHighlight) {
                        return;
                    }
                    root.mtAreas = areas;
                    root.mtText = text;
                    Qt.callLater(root.mtOpenFromHighlight);
                }
                function onAreaSelected(layer, sceneRect) {
                    if (root.mtFromHighlight && root.mtText) {
                        Qt.callLater(root.mtOpenFromHighlight);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
